regime_context: China A-shares show a narrow, two-horse leadership race: Banks (rank 1, eligible, crowded, broad) and Innovative Pharma & CXO (rank 2, eligible, crowded) hold nearly all the concentration while only 4 of 22 themes pass the absolute-trend gate. The backtest is explicit that the trend gate did_NOT_hold here (mean-reverting tape) and cross-sectional rank-IC is ~0, so this is a focus lens only — I am keeping convictions low and conditioning every lean on continuation rather than prediction.
emerging_watch: Watching whether Innovative Pharma & CXO (159992.SZ) CLOSES the 0.01 rotation margin versus Banks and holds the leader spot for 10 consecutive sessions — that would retire this watch by confirming a handoff; if the margin widens back in favour of Banks within that window, the watch retires as no handoff.

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks are the only theme combining eligibility (passed the absolute-trend gate), top durability (0.73), and genuine breadth (0.889) — a broad, cohesive leadership rather than a one-name squeeze. Momentum rank is explicitly not alpha, so I lean WITH the established leader on a trend-continuation basis, not on the rank itself. Crowding (z=1.78, crowded=true) is a size-down caution only, not a fade.
theses.dissent: The gate did_NOT_hold on this market's history, meaning eligibility is not a validated drawdown filter here; a mean-reverting tape could whipsaw Banks exactly as it did the benchmark, and the crowded flag marks it as late-stage.

falsifier.text: 512800.SS closes below its 20-day moving average and stays there for 5 consecutive sessions before the check-by date

theses.subject: Innovative Pharma & CXO
theses.thesis: Pharma & CXO is the rotation challenger (rotation.margin = 0.01), scoring 0.988 and eligible, with moderate durability (0.60) and breadth (0.643). The rotation radar shows a challenger within a hair of the leader, which is a confirmed handoff WATCH but not proof — I lean only on its own eligibility plus durability, not on rotation-timing (display_only, no edge).
theses.dissent: Rotation timing has no validated forward edge, so the near-tie with Banks tells us nothing about which wins; lower breadth means Pharma leadership is narrower and more fragile than Banks, and it is also crowded.

falsifier.text: 159992.SZ lags 512800.SS by 5% or more over any rolling 10-day window before the check-by date

theses.subject: Coal
theses.thesis: Coal is eligible and rank 6 with a mean-revert Hurst tag — on a market where the backtest explicitly shows the trend gate whipsaws (did_NOT_hold), a mean-reverting eligible leader is the exact case where the gate's edge is weakest. I'd avoid a directional lean entirely.
evidence: gate_helps=false → eligibility not a validated filter on this market
theses.dissent: Coal could grind higher if the value/cyclical rotation continues and the mean-revert tag simply means it hasn't trended yet.

falsifier.text: 515220.SS establishes a 30-day high and closes above it for 3 consecutive sessions before the check-by date

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
